body:
Overnight wiki-burn update: your ihatedanfrank Pro expired at midnight, so that account is done — no more batches go out on it. I also cleared two stale batches from yesterday back into the queue.

A fresh batch went out on dfrank88, but it's stuck at a Google check. Open Gmail on your iPhone, tap Yes, then tap 97 — there's no password option, just the tap. Say "done" here once you've tapped and I'll pick the session back up.

Overnight wiki tick is done. 112 chat messages from the overnight window are archived in the raw archive and the private backup — both landed.

New evidence logged: last night's avatar session (3 picks plus one video block), the KDP coloring-book debunk from last night, the breast-telemetry fix where the veto gate got corrected, and the 2010-texts handoff, which is still open.

Wiki edits: the avatar chronology got last night's session added, the attraction-guide telemetry log got the veto-gate fix, and one broken link-type on the tooling page got repaired.

The engine ran its top job — a defect sweep that found and fixed one bad link, and queued a follow-up for the same defect on the bunker-core page. Queue is healthy: one new evidence job got promoted but it's blocked waiting on you to boot a story-time or wiki-subject session, zero orphaned jobs. All quality gates clean, everything pushed, watermarks advanced.

Still open: those ~400 texts from 2010 are still waiting on your file drop (317 already came in through an earlier pull).

Token check, 2–3am: 22.5M total (22.2M in / 271k out). Heaviest: wiki-brain-writeback-6h (10.3M), then main agent (4.8M). Biggest single inference: wiki-brain-writeback-6h at 10.2M. Up ~162% vs last hour — the writeback run carried most of it.

Last night's system-files backup couldn't upload — your Google Drive is full, 2TB out of 2TB. The backup itself is fine, it's sitting on the machine, but the Drive copy is stuck at the last successful one until there's room. Free up some Drive space or add storage and the next nightly run will push normally.
Token check, 3:05–4:05am: 8.7M total (8.6M in / 190k out). Heaviest: main agent (4.0M), then stylo-v3-burnin-30m (1.3M). Biggest single inference: main agent at 723k. Down ~61% vs last hour.
Token check, 4:05–5:05am: 13.6M total (13.4M in / 215k out). Heaviest: main agent (9.9M), then stylo-v3-burnin-30m (1.1M). Biggest single inference: main agent at 575k. Up 56% vs last hour.

Token check, 5:05–6:05am: 4.3M total (4.3M in / 33.6k out). Heaviest: stylo-v3-burnin-30m (1.5M), then stylo-burnin-30m (1.1M). Biggest single inference: stylo-v3-burnin-30m at 873k. Down 68% vs last hour.
Token check, 6:05–7:05am: 7.3M total (7.2M in / 74k out). Heaviest: main agent (3.0M), then stylo-v3-burnin-30m (1.1M). Biggest single inference: stylo-v3-burnin-30m at 854k. Up ~68% vs last hour.
